source: PHC Core Rules v1.0: Essence of Experience (Levels and XP); starting-kit gear and its weights (Equipment slots, item weights; provisional)

items.name: Essence of Experience
items.text: Experience sealed in mana, worth 100 XP. Cracking it takes 10 minutes outside a fight, and someone with Brain Power 5 and an Evoker, or Will Power 5 and an Emanator. They choose who absorbs it: themselves or a party member who is present. A character can absorb one per long rest. It also sells well.

effects.limit: one absorbed per character per long rest

items.name: Stim injector
items.text: One dose. Use it on an ally next to you: it stabilises a Downed ally at 1 HP, or heals 30 × your Healing given. It also stops Bleeding.

items.name: Field kit
items.text: Bandages, splints and a suture set. What a Medic treats injuries with.

items.name: Ration pack
items.text: A day of food, sealed.

items.name: Evoker
items.text: Holds one mana core; the focus for Sigil magic.

items.name: Standard mana core
items.text: A core of condensed mana. An Evoker burns it for Sigils.

items.name: Sigil plate
items.text: A slate with one Sigil word cut into it. Study it for a scene to learn the word; the plate crumbles. Its note in your pack says which word it holds.

items.name: Heart plate
items.text: A violet-veined slate that holds one Outburst lesson: a tone (fire, storm, frost, stone, gale or acid), a school or a module. Study it for a scene to learn it; the plate crumbles. Its note in your pack says what it teaches.

items.name: Chalk and wax
items.text: For drawing sigils by hand.

items.name: Emanator
items.text: The heart link; the focus for Soul magic.

items.name: Prayer beads and incense
items.text: For prayer and patience.

items.name: Buckler
items.text: +1 Defense. Parry (reaction): +3 Defense against one melee attack. As a shield it gives you Shield Bash, Raise Shield and Shield Wall, and Brace and the Guard technique give 1 more Guard.

items.name: Legion riot shield
items.text: +2 Defense, and you count as behind half cover against shots from the front. −0.5 Movement. As a shield it gives you Shield Bash, Raise Shield and Shield Wall, and Brace and the Guard technique give 1 more Guard.

items.name: Pavise
items.text: Carried, it does nothing. Plant it for 2 AP and it becomes a tile of full cover in front of you, with 80 HP. Picking it back up costs 2 AP.

effects.note: Plant: becomes a pillar-class object in front of you.

items.name: Torch
items.text: Lights 4 tiles around you, so darkness doesn't halve your sight there. As a weapon it hits for 12 Elemental damage (Unarmed), and a hit on a roll of 15 or more sets the target Burning. It burns for 30 minutes.

items.name: Flare
items.text: Thrown or held, it lights 6 tiles for 3 rounds and reveals anyone Hidden there. It is used up.

items.name: Spare-parts charge
items.text: One charge of parts for Field Repair. A kit of five weighs 0.8 kg and costs 80 credits.

items.name: Red dot sight
items.text: Optic: no −2 to hit in the first range band past the weapon's effective range.

items.name: Scope
items.text: Optic: Aimed Shots get +1 to hit and one more range band before penalties start.

items.name: Suppressor
items.text: Muzzle: shots don't reveal you while you are Hidden. −2 damage.

items.name: Compensator
items.text: Muzzle: Recoil −1 per shot.

items.name: Extended magazine
items.text: Magazine: +50% capacity (rounded down).

items.name: Quick-release magazine
items.text: Magazine: reloading costs 1 AP.

items.name: Foregrip
items.text: Underbarrel: the first burst each turn ignores Recoil.

items.name: Bayonet
items.text: Underbarrel: melee attacks with the gun deal 15 damage (Athletics) instead of your fists' damage.

items.name: Underslung launcher
items.text: Underbarrel: holds one 40 mm grenade round.

items.name: Serrated edge
items.text: Edge: critical hits also cause Bleeding.

items.name: Weighted head
items.text: Edge: +3 damage.

items.name: Wrapped grip
items.text: Grip: you can't be Disarmed while you hold this weapon.

items.name: Sigil-etched magazine
items.text: Inscription: holds one stored Sigil spell.

items.name: Field helmet
items.text: Head: +10% Injury resistance.

items.name: Ballistic helmet
items.text: Head: +2 armour.

items.name: Night-sight goggles
items.text: Head accessory: darkness doesn't halve your sight.

items.name: Gas mask
items.text: Head accessory: toxic spills don't hurt you.

items.name: Padded undershirt
items.text: Inner torso: +1 armour.

items.name: Trauma plate insert
items.text: Inner torso: +3 armour.

items.name: Utility belt
items.text: Lower torso: +3 kg carry limit.

items.name: Armoured belt
items.text: Lower torso: +1 armour.

items.name: Armoured greaves
items.text: Legs: +2 armour; −0.5 Movement.

items.name: Runner's trousers
items.text: Legs: +0.5 Movement.

items.name: Work gloves
items.text: Hands: +2 Unarmed damage.

items.name: Combat gloves
items.text: Hands: +1 armour.

items.name: Field boots
items.text: Footwear: rough ground costs no extra.

items.name: Heavy boots
items.text: Footwear: +1 armour; +10% Injury resistance.

items.name: Musek Blestor
items.text: A palm-sized player with a speaker that can fill a hangar. The music traits start with one. It plays your favourite song for the room: 2 AP in a fight, or once per scene outside one.

items.name: Prescription glasses
items.text: Thick lenses. The trait Bottle Butts for Eyes checks whether you are wearing them.

items.name: Smiling mask
items.text: A mask with a fixed smile. The trait The Mask checks whether you are wearing it.

items.name: Prosthetic arm
items.text: A working arm of metal and wire. An arm injury hits the metal instead: the arm goes offline (Augment Offline) until it gets a Field Repair. With Improvisation 3 it can take up to 2 mods, fitted outside a fight; the Narrator decides what each mod does on it.

items.name: Central City ID
items.text: Proof of residence in Central City.

items.name: Bank card
items.text: An account in a Central City bank.

items.name: Contraband
items.text: Something the law wants back. The Narrator decides what it is.

items.name: Grimoire
items.text: Notes in a hand older than the cover.

items.name: Toolbox
items.text: Spanners, a crimper, wire. It counts as spare parts and as a field kit for any job that needs a toolbox.

items.name: Bottle of spirits
items.text: Something strong. The Lunarshine trait counts your drinks.

items.name: Pack of cigarettes
items.text: Twenty. The Chain Smoker trait counts them.

items.name: Drone frame
items.text: A folding combat drone. If you are a Drone Handler, it fights beside you.

items.name: Armour-piercing rounds
items.text: Armour-piercing rounds for any gun. Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. They ignore armour and deal 20% less damage.

items.name: Hollow-point rounds
items.text: Hollow-point rounds for any gun. Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. They deal 30% more damage, but the target's armour counts double.

items.name: Incendiary rounds
items.text: Incendiary rounds for any gun. Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. A hit sets the target Burning, and they deal 10% less damage.

items.name: Enhanced rounds
items.text: Enhanced rounds for any gun. Load them outside a fight to fill the magazine in the gun. They ignore armour, deal Elemental damage, and each hit raises the mana meter by 1.
